summary: Rebirth: pay a growing cost to reset a currency and gain a permanent earnings multiplier.

currency.description: A currency from the currency block

costGrowth.description: Each rebirth costs this many times the last

multiplierStep.description: Multiplier gained per rebirth (1 + rebirths x step), or the factor per rebirth when compound

compound.description: true: each rebirth multiplies (step^rebirths, e.g. 1.5x each time)
